description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage fintech team building US banking operations and core financial infrastructure. As a founding engineer, you will own backend systems that support programmable banking and digital asset services.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Ship production code early while learning the codebase, financial domain, and product.

 - Own major engineering projects from conception through production as an individual contributor.

 - Translate complex banking and financial problems into reliable software that operates at scale.

 - Make decisions on system design, data modeling, and architectural tradeoffs.

 - Work with engineering, product, and clients to shape the evolution of core banking systems.

 - Build simple systems that automate recurring problems and reduce manual effort.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of hands-on backend software engineering experience, including 1 or more years at an early-stage or small startup.

 - Experience shipping production software in banking, financial systems, or large-scale core infrastructure.

 - Experience owning substantial projects end-to-end and making production system design decisions.

 - Ability to deliver iteratively, maintain code quality, and take ownership of reliable systems.

 - Comfort working in new problem areas without an established playbook.

 - Strong interest in banking systems and financial infrastructure.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Annual base salary of $200,000 to $400,000, plus equity. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, and relocation support. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York. Relocation support is provided.
